import_builtin_datasets: import the builtin datasets module to register all COCO, LVIS, and Chimp'n'See datasets for DensePose
register_coco_datasets: call register_coco_datasets with a datasets dict and root path to register COCO-based DensePose datasets
register_lvis_datasets: call register_lvis_datasets with a datasets dict and root path to register LVIS-based DensePose datasets
register_chimpnsee_dataset: call register_chimpnsee_dataset with a root path to register the Chimp'n'See DensePose dataset
use_default_datasets_root: use the DEFAULT_DATASETS_ROOT constant which defaults to 'datasets' as the base path for all registered datasets
